Plugin.Name: Vulkan Support
Plugin.Description:
Vulkan loader, vulkaninfo and NVIDIA Vulkan ICD configuration for Unraid. Needed for Vulkan workloads in Docker containers such as RealityScan (RSNode under Wine) and Blender.
Features: - Vulkan loader and vulkaninfo, Vulkan SDK 1.4.363.0, built from the Khronos sources - Uses the NVIDIA driver's own ICD manifest, generates one only if it is missing - Web page: driver, ICD source, loader version, vulkaninfo summary, Docker settings
Docker: --runtime=nvidia -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=all -e NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all (optional: -v /etc/vulkan/icd.d:/etc/vulkan/icd.d:ro)
Requirements: - Unraid 6.10+ - NVIDIA GPU - NVIDIA Driver plugin installed
Plugin.Changes:
### 2026.10.27 - Vulkan loader and vulkaninfo 1.4.363.0 (was 1.3.204), runs on Unraid 6.10+ - Slackware package naming, clean upgrade and removal - The NVIDIA driver's ICD manifest is preferred; generated only if missing - Warning when the NVIDIA driver is missing - No global VK_ICD_FILENAMES export any more - Web page: ICD source, loader version, vulkaninfo with timeout - One Docker recommendation (--runtime=nvidia), RealityScan RSNode example
